subject: design/feature-draft
statement: A reopened draft lock verifies its first commit against the binding version, requires changed contract text, and refuses reused numbers or retired row IDs.
intent: Keep every locked version grounded in its approved predecessor and preserve stable per-feature identities.
rationale: An older or hand-seeded draft can undo prior edits; reused history numbers collide with retained records. Retrospective planning checks exempt the already locked version from its own number-reuse test.
fit_criterion: Fixtures refuse stale, hand-seeded, unchanged, and unreadable reopen inputs; numbering fixtures refuse reused history and retired IDs; plan precheck accepts the locked version; the memory gate refuses an in-place edit with a reopen remedy.
